name: Azuma Io
source:
"Harukawa-san... um... I was just wondering what kind of person she likes..."

Suzuna’s childhood friend.
A sincere and honest boy, so slender and delicate in appearance that he could easily be mistaken for a girl. Scholarly by nature, he has an interest in folklore and has been staying at the Kuraki household for the past few days in a student-like position. He harbors a quiet affection for Tomomi Harukawa, one of the household’s servants.

[From the [url=https://aridesign.co.jp/root/nsmr/character.html]official site[/url].]
